claims.claim: This is a dirt 4 shockwave sport bicycle
claims.evidence: Witness report does not show any readable brand/model/nameplate; only a red-and-white mountain bicycle with front suspension and disc brake is visible.
Witness report clearly shows front suspension fork; it does not confirm rear suspension (no rear shock/dual-suspension evidence in the report).
Front disc brake is visible; the report says front (and possibly rear) disc brake, so rear brake is not confirmed.
Witness report mentions a motorized bicycle style and visible handlebar/brake levers, but does not confirm gears/shifters/cassette details.

risks.risk: Motor/engine may not run or may not produce power (no test shown).
risks.proof: A short video clip of the motor starting and running under load (moving forward) plus sound/idle stability.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a non-tested/possibly non-working motorized bicycle.

risks.risk: Rear suspension and/or rear disc brake may not exist or may be non-functional (seller says dual, witness only confirms front).
risks.proof: Photos/clip showing the rear shock/suspension and a clear view of the rear rotor/caliper and brake actuation.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as front-suspension only and front disc only (worst-case vs claimed dual).

risks.risk: Drivetrain may be worn or gears may not shift smoothly (chain/sprockets/cassette not assessed).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of chain and sprockets plus a clip showing gear shifting through all gears while pedaling.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as drivetrain needing service/unknown shifting performance.

risks.risk: Brakes may be weak or uneven (pads/rotors wear not shown; only disc presence is noted).
risks.proof: Clip of braking test: rider applies both brakes and bike stops quickly; close-ups of pads/rotors condition.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as brakes unverified/possibly needing pad/rotor service.

risks.risk: Tires/tubes may be damaged or may not hold air (tread depth/sidewall cracks not shown).
risks.proof: Photos of tire tread and sidewalls plus a clip showing the bike rolling and checking for leaks (or pressure check).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as tires/tubes possibly needing replacement.

risks.risk: Frame/motor mounting may have hidden cracks, misalignment, or unsafe mounting (only one angle shown).
risks.proof: Multiple-angle photos of frame welds and motor mounting points; close-up of any dents/cracks; straightness check clip.

risks.risk: Missing components/accessories (charger/tools/keys/spare parts) or incomplete motor setup.
risks.proof: Photo list of included items and a shot showing the full motor system completeness (carb/filters/wiring/controls) and any keys/charger.

proof_requests: Video of the motor starting and running, then moving the bike forward (with sound).
Clear photos of rear suspension (if any) and rear disc brake rotor/caliper.
Close-ups of drivetrain: chain, sprockets/cassette, and shifters; plus a shifting test video.
Brake test clip showing both brakes stopping the bike, and close-ups of pads/rotors.
Tire close-ups (tread + sidewalls) and confirmation tires hold air (pressure check).
Multiple angles of frame and motor mounting points to check for cracks/dents and secure mounting.
Photos of what’s included: charger/tools/keys and any spare parts; confirm motor system completeness.
response.reason: The witness can identify it as a motorized mountain bicycle with front suspension and a visible front disc brake, so it can be priced at its worst-case condition. However, motor functionality, rear brake/suspension, drivetrain, brakes, tires, and completeness are unverified, so the price should reflect those uncertainties.
